notes.title: The 1.4 is repaired and available!
notes.notes:
This version 1.4 of Spacer Project brings above all the new control system in the game and the possibility to configure its keys!

From now on, we are waiting for the feedback on the game. 
We are open to all proposals!

We have in mind to be able to bring an online scoring system if you wish, especially successes on Steam!

notes.title: Temporary Fix
notes.notes:
An issue make trouble for launching a game, we temporary fix it with the previous version.

The version 1.3 is on, and we fix the 1.4.

notes.title: Spacer Project available in 3 days
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
	It is with great pleasure that we announce the official steam launch of TheRed Games' first game. It will be available in 3 days.

	Spacer Project has been a development adventure for more than a year! A student project that wanted to be a first hand in video game development.

	Obviously any constructive feedback will be good to take and I'll try to put updates according to it!

	Thanks in advance and... to your space-ships!
